goals: Recognize selected images on the configured remote development API CPU without creating descriptions or starting GPU work.
Expose the one-shot action only when WordPress is local/development and the effective hosted API is one of the explicitly mapped development deployments. Server rechecks on every submission.
Reuse scan progress, cancellation, failure recovery, clustering, projection and existing evidence review. Manual diagnosis is not a benchmark or a model winner claim.
One fixed model per LocalWP instance, selected only in that instance's API settings. The command runs that pipeline; its target display is read-only.

jobs.label: Inspect faces and occlusion outcomes on one isolated development model stack

screens.title: Review Queue media selection
screens.purpose: Select images; Describe selected remains the normal primary. A collapsed Developer tools disclosure offers a separate CPU face-only command. Production/demo/staging environments and unknown settings omit this disclosure.

zones.label: Selected image thumbnails and filenames, shared with Describe

Collapsed Developer tools; read-only configured API target; Run FIR pipeline (CPU). Preview explains selected image count, recognition writes and no descriptions/GPU. Disabled with an explanation for empty selection, recognition off, offline or another active operation. One fixed model per LocalWP instance; this command runs its configured pipeline.

screens.title: Face-only run activity
screens.purpose: Accepted work uses existing scan progress, Cancel, stream Retry and job history beside the selected media. Starting is pending; failures remain visible and do not start descriptions. Collapsing developer disclosure does not hide the shared job activity.

zones.label: Existing face scan progress, phase and processed counts; polite announcement; Cancel; read-only stream Retry

screens.title: Existing face review
screens.purpose: Inspect found face boxes beside the source image and review suggestions in the existing queue; unknown or missed faces remain observable. Completion never promises a match, complete coverage, a model winner or a new description.

zones.label: Existing source image, face boxes and recognition evidence; empty and error states remain distinct

actions.target: POST recognition/analyze {development_faces_only:true}; existing scan pipeline only

flows.label: Run selected media through CPU recognition only

steps.branch_label: Select images; expand Developer tools; inspect target and count; invoke face-only action
Pending then observed progress; no Describe callback
Terminal success: inspect actual face results, including unknown or empty

flows.label: Recover without a description or hidden GPU work

steps.branch_label: Cancel or typed error; keep selection, show outcome; stream Retry only reconnects
A new face scan requires another explicit command

not_doing: No persistent processing-mode switch or relabelled Describe button.
No per-request model switching, embedding-space mixing, production/demo access or local laptop execution.
No comparison metrics, ground-truth editor or claim that the face UI chooses AuraFace vs SFace. Use the existing isolated benchmark harness and fixed occlusion corpus.
No new review tab, modal, navigation hierarchy or GPU readiness gate.
